One of the Best Indian Restaurants in Da Nang
Jul 2026 • Solo
If you’re in Da Nang and enjoy great Indian food and exceptional service, I highly recommend you visit Manvar Rasoi.

* Service:
- Ms. Thuy, Yogendra and Manu were extremely welcoming and friendly,
- Everyone I interacted with was amazing!
- Overall, the service was exceptional!
- Rating: 5/5

* Atmosphere:
- They have indoor and outdoor seating.
- Outdoors: Although I didn’t see any fans, I’m sure they would move some to ensure their customers are comfortable.
- Indoors: To keep you cool they have air conditioning and portable fans.
- Seating: High-back plastic wicker chairs.
- They had one TV showing videos and playing background music.
- Rating: 5/5

Excellent food, wonderful hospitality, and a very welcoming atmosphere. We will definitely come back! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Aug 2026 • Family
We had a wonderful family dinner at Manvar Rasoi Indian Restaurant on 3 August 2026, and it was honestly one of the best Indian dining experiences we’ve had in Vietnam.

The food was absolutely delicious—authentic, flavorful, and beautifully prepared. Everything we tried was excellent, and I can confidently say this is some of the best Indian food in Vietnam. 🇮🇳❤️

What made the experience even better was the hospitality. The restaurant manager and the entire staff were incredibly kind, welcoming, and attentive. They were happy to recommend dishes and took the time to make sure we were comfortable and enjoying our meal.

I especially appreciated their recommendations, which made choosing what to order much easier and helped us discover some really delicious dishes.

We had a lovely time dining with our family and would definitely recommend Manvar Rasoi to anyone looking for great Indian food and genuinely warm service in Vietnam.

Excellent food, wonderful hospitality, and a very welcoming atmosphere. We will definitely come back! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Delicious Indian Cuisine and excellent value!
Jul 2026 • Family
Manvar Rasoi was one of the highlights of our time in Da Nang. From the moment we arrived, the service was exceptional—warm, attentive and genuinely friendly throughout our meal. The staff made us feel very welcome and were always happy to help with recommendations, creating a relaxed and enjoyable dining experience.

The food was just as impressive. The vindaloo was wonderfully rich, fragrant and packed with bold, authentic flavour, while the butter chicken was perfectly cooked with a deliciously creamy, well-balanced sauce. To top it all off, the fresh mango lassis were absolutely delicious and the perfect accompaniment to the meal. If you're looking for authentic Indian food with outstanding service, Manvar Rasoi is an easy five-star recommendation.

Poor Service and Cold Food – Avoid
Mar 2026 • Couples
Manvar Rasoi Indian Restaurant delivered a deeply disappointing experience, failing on hygiene, service, and food quality. The presence of houseflies on the table immediately set an unhygienic tone.
Service was lackluster; we waited 35 minutes for our meal without any staff updates. When the food finally arrived, basic necessities like service spoons and bowls were missing, making sharing difficult. Compounding the frustration, the roti and paratha were served cold. Between the sluggish service and the mediocre taste, the meal felt like a poor value. I cannot recommend this spot until they address these fundamental issues.
